summary: Encapsulates database infrastructure functionality, including connection management, ORM models, repositories, transactions, error handling, and data mapping using SQLAlchemy.
responsibilities: Manage database connections, ORM models, persistence repositories, transactions, error handling, and schema mapping.
relationships: The repository and transaction components depend on connection management and ORM models for database operations.
design_decisions: Organizes database infrastructure into modular subcomponents including connection management, models, repositories, transactions, mapping, and error handling.
Relies on SQLAlchemy as the underlying persistence and ORM framework across components.
